pendingActions: PARTIALLY RESOLVED / STILL WORTH UNDERSTANDING: the CI-triggering picture is more nuanced than first diagnosed. Billing is confirmed NOT the cause (checked directly: 0/2,000 Actions minutes used this period, $0 net billable, no spending cap). No webhooks and no installed GitHub Apps exist on the repo either. However, master push events ARE being received and DO queue a 'Staging Deploy' run each time (concurrency group 'deploy-group') -- most of these sit in 'waiting' status indefinitely (9 queued since 2026-08-13T20:12, only one -- the wugs-s13 merge commit 6ea307f9 -- ever actually dequeued and ran). Still genuinely unexplained: why PR-branch pull_request-triggered checks (PR Checks, Assurance Gate, etc.) show zero runs at all for recent commits, and why 8 of 9 queued Staging Deploy runs never dequeue despite the concurrency group's holder finishing. Repo Settings -> Actions general page (https://github.com/heymishy/skills-repo/settings/actions) was suggested but not yet confirmed by the operator. If this keeps mattering, GitHub Support is the next real step (a precise report is ready: push/pull_request events inconsistently triggering runs that then get stuck 'waiting' in a concurrency queue that mostly never drains, while workflow_dispatch/schedule triggers and the one queued run that did dequeue all worked normally).
